**R6 erratum for the five #961 ADR amendments**

Issue #973: PR #972 promoted five ADR amendments (0002/3, 0011/1, 0014/1, 0017/3, 0034/1) whose signed sections said the body was not rewritten, although the same act annotated it in place under R6 as amended (option A). Each ADR gets an erratum amendment through brain:promote that rewrites that sentence, marked with the section 1c act 2 literal **[Amended by Amendment N (#973)]**. Lessons: a signed claim about an act must be checked against the act; stated counts drift, so leave them out; memory:save with one positional silently writes content ending in undefined (#928).
